user.description: The entity runs from the start time to the end time on the days you pick. An end time earlier than the start time carries the interval past midnight into the next day.

data_description.end: When the interval ends, in whole minutes. Earlier than the start means the next day.

add_time.name: Add time
add_time.description: Adds minutes to the countdown of a timer, or takes them off with a negative number. Adding to a timer that is not running starts it; taking off all the time that is left turns the entity off. A countdown never goes beyond one day.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How many minutes to move the end of the countdown by, up to a day either way.

run.name: Run
run.description: Turns the entity on, for the minutes given or else for the default duration in strict mode and without a countdown in loose mode, with the settings given if the entity supports them.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to run, in whole minutes, up to a day. Without it the entity runs for the default duration in strict mode and without a countdown in loose mode.

hvac_mode.description: The mode to turn a climate entity on in.

add_command.name: Add command
add_command.description: Keeps a command to turn the entity on or off at a time you choose, a number of minutes from now or at a moment. A command to turn on can run for some minutes and set the entity up with the settings given. It is carried out at its time whatever state the entity is in then, and using the entity by hand does not cancel it. The response holds the command's id, which cancels it.

action.name: Action
action.description: Whether to turn the entity on or off at that time.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: In how many minutes to carry the command out, up to a week. Give this or a time, not both.

at.name: Time
at.description: When to carry the command out, up to a week ahead. A time without a time zone is in Home Assistant's time zone. Give this or a delay, not both.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long a command to turn on runs, in whole minutes, up to a day. Without it the entity runs for the default duration in strict mode and without a countdown in loose mode. A command to turn off takes none.

hvac_mode.name: HVAC mode
hvac_mode.description: The mode to turn a climate entity on in.

temperature.name: Temperature

preset_mode.name: Preset mode
preset_mode.description: The preset mode of a fan.

percentage.name: Speed
percentage.description: The speed of a fan, in percent.

humidity.name: Humidity

cancel_command.name: Cancel command
cancel_command.description: Cancels a pending command before its time. Aim the call at the timer that holds the command; another timer does not know it. The id is in the response of Add command and in the attributes of the Next command sensor.

command_id.name: Command ID
command_id.description: The id of the command to cancel.

target_not_found.message: The entity this timer was set up for no longer exists. Remove this timer and add it again for another entity.

not_whole_minutes.message: Run for takes a whole number of minutes; {minutes} is not one.

setting_not_supported.message: {target} cannot be turned on with the setting {setting}.

setting_out_of_range.message: {value} is not a valid {setting}: it must be between {min} and {max}.

setting_not_an_option.message: {value} is not a valid {setting}: it must be one of {options}.

delay_or_at.message: Give the command either a delay or a time, not both and not neither.

off_takes_no_duration_or_settings.message: A command to turn off takes no minutes and no settings.

command_in_past.message: {at} has already passed. Pick a time that is still ahead.

command_too_far.message: A command can be set at most {days} days ahead.

too_many_commands.message: {target} already has {limit} pending commands. Cancel one before adding another.

unknown_command.message: This timer has no pending command with the id {command_id}. Cancel a command through the timer that holds it.

timer_unloaded.message: This timer was unloaded while the call waited, so nothing was changed. Try again once the timer is loaded.
